page.overview:
What is Murtlap?

The Murtlap was a magical marine beast resembling a rat with a growth on its back similar to a sea anemone, found on the coastal areas of Britain.

The favoured prey of the Murtlap were crustaceans, though they also went for the feet of any human foolish enough to step on them.

The growth on the Murtlap's back may be pickled and eaten to improve one's resistance to jinxes, although eating an excess of pickled Murtlap may cause one to grow unsightly purple ear hair.

Murtlap tentacles were included in Murtlap Essence, a home remedy for cuts and abrasions, which Hermione Granger once made for Harry Potter to heal the cuts on his hand after his detention with Dolores Umbridge. Getting bit by a Murtlap was usually not serious, but some reactions to it could cause sweating, twitching and flames out of the anus.
